estimate_report.method: Profile least squares of log-distance RSSI, with one intercept per MAC

weighted_receiver_centroid.note: Signal-power-weighted receiver centroid; not a triangulated AP position

warnings: Combined fit assumes all selected MAC addresses are stationary and co-located; a shared SSID does not prove this.
The search radius is a user-chosen planning radius, not a confidence interval.
RSSI-to-distance parameters are uncalibrated; walls, antenna patterns and changes between surveys can bias the fit.
GPS accuracy describes receiver positions, not access point location uncertainty.
Measurements are 2D; receiver altitudes do not establish transmitter height.
Survey dates differ; constant transmitter position and per-radio power are assumptions.
